name: Clicking a team row in Group A then in Group L lands on two distinct destinations
description: When a visitor opens Group A and clicks a team row, then returns and opens Group L and clicks a team row, the two destinations are different URLs — proving each group's rows are individually navigable and bound to a distinct destination.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the group standings area
Click the first team row in Group A
Note the current destination URL as the Group A destination
Scroll down to Group L in the group standings area
Click the first team row in Group L
Verify the current destination URL differs from the noted Group A destination URL
